memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine check‑up for hypertension, BPH and depressive symptoms.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Mr reports occasional headaches, mild urinary frequency and low mood over the past month. He denies chest pain, palpitations or weight loss.

EXAMINATION: BP 148/92 mmHg, pulse 78/min, regular. Weight 78 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 27.6 (obese). Abdomen soft, prostate not enlarged on digital rectal exam. No focal neurological deficits.

IMPRESSION: Hypertension stage 2, benign prostatic hyperplasia with mild lower urinary tract symptoms, depression moderate (PHQ‑9 to be checked). Labs ordered: fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, serum creatinine/eGFR, potassium, PSA, urine routine, TSH, vitamin B12.

ARRANGEMENTS: Start amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, tamsulosin 0.4 mg HS, sertraline 50 mg OD. Advise low‑salt diet, regular walking 30 min daily, weight reduction. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39 °C, or blood in stools. Influenza vaccine not due yet.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: 3‑month follow‑up of hypertension, BPH and depression.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Headaches improved, urinary frequency unchanged, mood better but occasional fatigue.

EXAMINATION: BP 132/84 mmHg, pulse 76/min. Weight 77 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 27.3 (obese). Abdomen soft, prostate mildly enlarged on DRE.

IMPRESSION: Hypertension controlled on current regimen. BPH symptoms stable. Depression improved (PHQ‑9 8). Labs show normal lipids, eGFR 66, K+ 4.3, PSA 1.3.

ARRANGEMENTS: Increase amlodipine to 5 mg BD, add finasteride 5 mg OD, continue telmisartan, tamsulosin, sertraline. Reinforce diet, activity, weight goal <75 kg. Return if chest pain, dyspnoea, fever >39 °C, gross hematuria, or worsening low mood. Influenza vaccine not yet due.

memories.text:
Reason for visit: Autumn review of hypertension, BPH and depression; influenza vaccine due.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Occasional dizziness on standing, urinary frequency unchanged, mood stable.

EXAMINATION: BP 138/88 mmHg, pulse 78/min. Weight 76 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 26.9 (overweight). Abdomen soft, prostate mildly enlarged.

IMPRESSION: Hypertension controlled, slight orthostatic dizziness possibly from amlodipine. BPH stable. Depression in remission (PHQ‑9 5). Labs: lipids improved, eGFR 68, K+ 4.2, PSA 1.4.

ARRANGEMENTS: Hold amlodipine morning dose, keep telmisartan 40 mg OD, add hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD for BP control, continue finasteride, tamsulosin, sertraline. Give influenza vaccine today (05‑Oct‑2025). Advise salt restriction, regular exercise, weight <70 kg. Return if chest pain, syncope, fever >39 °C, blood in urine, or worsening depression.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: Scheduled follow‑up; patient reports improved urinary flow, occasional nocturia.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Better urinary stream, nocturia 1‑2 times/night, mood good, no dizziness.

EXAMINATION: BP 130/82 mmHg, pulse 74/min. Weight 75 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 26.5 (overweight). Abdomen soft, prostate mildly enlarged.

IMPRESSION: Hypertension well controlled. BPH symptoms improved (IPSS down). Depression stable (PHQ‑9 4). Labs pending.

ARRANGEMENTS: Continue telmisartan 40 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD, finasteride 5 mg OD, tamsulosin 0.4 mg HS, sertraline 50 mg OD. Reinforce pelvic floor exercises, limit evening fluids. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39 °C, gross hematuria, or suicidal thoughts. Influenza vaccine already given.

Reason for visit: Annual review of chronic conditions; influenza vaccine due for next season.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Occasional fatigue, urinary frequency unchanged, mood stable.

EXAMINATION: BP 128/80 mmHg, pulse 72/min. Weight 74 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 26.2 (overweight). Abdomen soft, prostate mildly enlarged.

IMPRESSION: Hypertension at target. BPH controlled. Depression in remission (PHQ‑9 3). Annual labs: lipids within normal, eGFR 71, K+ 4.1, PSA 1.5, TSH normal, B12 adequate.

ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Advise maintain weight <70 kg, daily walk, low‑salt diet. Give influenza vaccine today (30‑Jun‑2026). Return if chest pain, dyspnoea, fever >39 °C, blood in urine or stool, or worsening mood.
